patterns.note: Content sections frequently use full-bleed imagery within a grid layout for article and recipe cards, creating a visually rich and immersive experience.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established using a bold, condensed sans-serif for large display text and section titles, an elegant serif for article headings, and a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation labels.

The site primarily uses a high-contrast dark mode palette, featuring a deep charcoal background, off-white surfaces for content cards, and crisp white text, accented by subtle dark grey for modal overlays.
A site-wide age verification modal is triggered on page load, overlaying and dimming all content until user interaction.
A massive, stylized brand name ('MEASURED') is used as a fixed background element, creating a strong visual anchor that foreground content scrolls over, adding depth and persistent branding.

Major content sections are clearly delineated by full-width blocks, often alternating between dark backgrounds and lighter card grids, with the large background brand text acting as a visual separator and anchor.

technique_notes: Implement a full-screen overlay with a dark, semi-transparent backdrop that appears on page load, containing an age verification form with distinct 'yes' and 'no' buttons. The main navigation bar should be set to a fixed position at the top of the viewport. A large, stylized brand logo or text element should be positioned as a fixed background element with a low opacity, allowing page content to scroll over it, creating a layered depth effect and persistent brand presence. Content is structured in responsive grid layouts, with article and recipe cards featuring full-bleed images and clear typographic labels.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold, condensed sans-serif display text (~8x body) for brand and section titles, paired with elegant serif headings (~2x body) for article titles, and a clean sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle for interactive elements like buttons and input fields, sharp for image cards and overall section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in hero and between major sections, balanced within content grids.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the massive, semi-transparent 'MEASURED' brand name used as a persistent, fixed background element across the homepage. This creates a powerful, almost architectural brand presence that anchors the entire scrolling experience, giving the site a unique sense of depth and sophisticated identity beyond a typical content platform.
